system.description:
While not as skilled as the Nox, you can use advanced mental techniques honed by years of pacifism to hide yourself from view. As an action you may gain the invisible condition for one minute (10 rounds of combat). You may use 
this ability a number of times per long rest equal to your Proficiency bonus. If you take an action affecting a non-friendly target (such as an attack), your invisibility ends
system.bonus: Gain the invisible condition for one minute (10 rounds of combat). If you take an action affecting a non-friendly target (such as an attack), your invisibility ends
